feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump meets with top tech leaders to discuss regulations and launch new website
entry.summary: President Trump met with top tech leaders Tuesday as he rolled out an AI-driven website, America.gov, to help citizens navigate government services.

entry.title: Takeaways from Trump's summit with AI leaders
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with AI policy expert Aalok Mehta about President Trump's AI Summit with tech industry leaders.

entry.title: Former special counsel Jack Smith defends investigation into Trump on Capitol Hill
entry.summary: Former Justice Department special counsel Jack Smith defended two criminal indictments against President Trump on Capitol Hill.

entry.title: 'NAZA' filmmakers on what they learned making the doc and the backlash it received
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with the filmmakers of "NAZA," a documentary that features interviews with Israeli intelligence officers and soldiers who describe targeting Palestinians in Gaza.

entry.title: FBI investigating massive data breach of the bureau's job portal
entry.summary: The FBI says it's addressing a massive data breach, vowing to go after the hackers they believe are responsible.

entry.title: Negotiator of 2015 Iran nuclear deal discusses Trump rejecting Iran's latest proposal
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Robert Malley, a negotiator of the 2015 Iran nuclear deal, about where talks stand after President Trump rejected Iran's offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

entry.title: Outside groups are spending millions on races that could determine Senate control
entry.summary: New Hampshire's Senate race is one of a handful that could determine control of Congress next year. That's why outside money groups are plowing big money into it — some $50 million to date.

entry.title: How low-cost climate solutions are helping cities recover from major storms faster
entry.summary: Cities like New York are bouncing back faster from major rainfall and flash flooding, thanks to smart, low-cost climate solutions.

entry.title: U.S. military withdraws from Iraq two decades after invasion
entry.summary: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

entry.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
entry.summary: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.
